generationInputs.prompt: The image shows a stylized design incorporating agricultural elements. A thick, dark green shape resembling the left side of a heart or a developing vine begins at the bottom left, arcs upwards and to the right, and then curves back down and slightly to the left. Completing the heart shape on the right is a stylized wheat stalk, depicted in shades of golden yellow and light brown. Inside this heart shape are four individual agricultural elements, each a different color. The top element is green and leaf-shaped, oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right, representing an avocado. Below and slightly to the left is a yellow, elongated shape pointing upwards and slightly to the left, representing a banana. A blue, leaf-like shape is positioned centrally, pointing downwards and slightly to the left, representing a cluster of grapes. To the right is a red, horizontally oriented shape with a slight indentation at the top, representing an apple. A thin, light green stem extends from the bottom of the grape shape and extends downwards, partially obscured by the apple. The entire design is set against a plain white background. The style is flat and graphic, with solid colors and no shading or texture visible.
